tips.title: Save first
tips.description: Set aside part of your income for saving before spending.

tips.title: Avoid small daily expenses
tips.description: Small daily expenses can affect your monthly budget.

tips.title: Use credit responsibly

tips.title: Have an emergency fund
tips.description: Reserve money for unforeseen events and avoid debt.

tips.description: Financial knowledge is an investment that pays off long-term.

microlessons.content: An asset puts money in your pocket, a liability takes it out.
Compound interest earns interest on interest, unlike simple interest.
Don't put all your eggs in one basket: diversify your investments.
Inflation reduces your money's purchasing power over time.
Your payment history and debt affect your credit score.
Tracking income and expenses helps avoid debt.
A financial cushion for unforeseen events reduces stress and risk.
Interest can make your debt grow fast or your savings increase.
Using credit wisely improves your score and prevents financial trouble.
Setting clear goals makes it easier to achieve financial stability.

quiz.recommendation: Remember that compound interest means earning interest on accumulated interest.
An asset is something that puts money in your pocket, like an investment.
Inflation makes your money lose purchasing power over time.

quiz.text: What is a good financial habit?
quiz.recommendation: Saving first ensures you build a financial cushion.

quiz.text: What does it mean to diversify your investments?
quiz.recommendation: Diversification reduces the risk of losing everything.
A liability takes money out of your pocket, like loans or credit cards.

quiz.text: What is the purpose of an emergency fund?
quiz.recommendation: An emergency fund helps avoid using credit in emergencies.

quiz.text: How does responsible credit use benefit you?
quiz.recommendation: Using credit wisely builds your credit score and financial reputation.

quiz.text: What is the main advantage of budgeting?
quiz.recommendation: Budgeting helps control finances and avoid debt.

quiz.text: Why should you plan for retirement early?
quiz.recommendation: Early planning allows your money to grow and provides peace of mind.
